marketplace.name: adityaarakeri
marketplace.description: Adi's Skill Stack: agent skills for engineering discipline, writing, design, and judgment.

bundle.name: astack
bundle.tagline: Installs every plugin in this catalog in one step.
bundle.description: Meta-plugin with no skills of its own. Installing it installs every plugin in the Astack catalog as a dependency.

plugins.name: senior-agent-skills
plugins.tagline: Makes a coding agent plan, test, and verify before shipping.
plugins.description: Ten skills that give a coding agent senior habits: recon a repo, plan first, test-driven loops, safe refactors, debugging, self-review, git hygiene, dead-code audits, and verifying work is actually done.

plugins.name: yolo
plugins.tagline: Hands an agent one goal and stays out of the way.
plugins.description: Autonomous mode: give the agent a single goal and let it plan, execute, and verify without stopping to ask.

plugins.name: context-relay-tdd
plugins.tagline: Audits a repo, then fixes it one test-first item at a time, across context resets.
plugins.description: Writes an audit to a RELAY.md work queue in the repo, then fixes each item red-green-refactor with one commit per item, so any session or agent can resume where the last one stopped.

plugins.name: humanize-content
plugins.tagline: Strips AI tells from text without adding new ones.
plugins.description: Rewrites AI-generated or robotic text so it reads like one specific person wrote it, and audits drafts for AI tells, without introducing the second-order tells most humanizers add.

plugins.name: handcraft-html
plugins.tagline: Builds HTML pages that do not read as generated.
plugins.description: Builds documentation, runbooks, references, and portfolios as HTML that looks hand-made, with named light and dark themes and mobile layouts by default.

plugins.name: frontend-engineering
plugins.tagline: Senior frontend judgment for framework apps.
plugins.description: Component boundaries, state placement, data fetching, accessibility, performance, and browser verification for React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Angular, and Solid apps.

plugins.name: judgment-coach
plugins.tagline: Coaches a decision instead of making it for you.
plugins.description: Walks you through a decision: the real question, hidden options, what matters, reversibility, missing information, and your own lean, then leaves you with a short recap.
